p: prayed: After she had obtained a son by prayer she gave thanks.
horn is exalted in the LORD: I have recovered strength and glory by the benefit of the Lord.
enlarged over mine enemies: I can answer them that criticize my barrenness.
no more so exceeding proudly: In that you condemn my barrenness, you show your pride against God.
bread: They sell their labours for necessary food.
princes: He prefers to honour, and does according to his own will, though man's judgment is contrary.
LORD'S: Therefore he may dispose all things according to his will.
king: She grounded her prayer on Jesus Christ who was to come.
LORD before Eli the priest: In all that Eli commanded him.
knew not the LORD: That is, they neglected his ordinance.
all that the fleshhook brought up: Transgressing the order appointed in the Law, Le 7:31, for their bellies sake.
fat: Which was commanded first to have been offered to God.
desireth: Not passing for their own profit, so that God might be served rightly.
abhorred the offering of the LORD: Seeing the horrible abuse of it.
assembled at the door of the: Which was (as the Hebrews write) after their travail, when they came to be purified, read Ex 38:8, Le 12:6.
transgress: Because they contemn their duty to God, 1Sa 2:17.
would slay them: So that to obey good admonition is God's mercy, and to disobey them is his just judgment for sin.
father: That is, Aaron.
kick ye at my sacrifice and: Why have you contemned my sacrifices, and as it were trod them under foot?
Be it far from me: God's promises are only effective to those he gives faith to fear and obey him.
arm: Thy power and authority.
shalt see an enemy in my: Your posterity will see the glory of the chief priest given to another, whom they will envy, 1Ki 2:27.
faithful priest: Meaning Zadok, who succeeded Abiathar, and was the figure of Christ.
crouch to him for a piece: That is, will be inferior to him.
